scientific_question: Does the frozen B candidate detector location contain a unique positive one-frame local residual above the broad same-y detector-edge pedestal when compared against a dense, pixel-selection-independent detector-matched ensemble?

immutable_inputs.fit_model: Identical fixed-centroid circular Gaussian plus planar background estimator used in Q4B.

dense_control_grid.candidate_neighborhood_exclusion: exclude any x with abs(x-target_x) < 128 pixels
dense_control_grid.patch_overlap: 17-pixel patches at 32-pixel spacing do not overlap each other

primary_statistic.control_center: median of the 55 frozen control T(x) values
primary_statistic.control_scale: 1.4826*MAD around the control median; sample standard deviation fallback only if MAD is nonpositive

null_sensitivity_gate.purpose: A raw non-unique result may be called qualified only if the unchanged estimator could recover a clearly unique positive B residual at the same frozen target location.
null_sensitivity_gate.injection: Add the frozen B-frame Gaussian template at the target detector coordinate with peak amplitude equal to 5 times the pre-injection dense-control temporal-contrast robust scale; A and C unchanged.
null_sensitivity_gate.required: The injected target must pass the exact same residual-z and empirical-rank gate.

interpretation.if_unique_residual: A unique one-frame local B excess above the broad detector pedestal is supported, but its sky versus detector origin remains unresolved and requires a new gate.
interpretation.if_qualified_no_unique_residual: No unique local B residual is supported at the preregistered 5-control-sigma sensitivity scale. This strengthens a broad detector/background explanation for Q4B but does not exclude a smaller one-frame sky transient.

not_admitted: No control may be removed because it contains an astronomical source or inconvenient value.
No claim that empirical rank fractions are exact independent-trial p-values; same-row detector structure can be correlated.
No proof of a specific bad-pixel, cosmic-ray, persistence, or electronics mechanism.
No exclusion of sky transients below the preregistered residual sensitivity.
No reopening of the closed ZTF/TESS timing-replication line.
No tachyon, FTL, retrocausal, UAP, artificial, ETI, or nuclear-causality interpretation.
